items.title: Plas Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996
items.q: My father played banjo in the early days and saxophone later. He was a senior, I’m a junior.

ctx.x: Were you from a musical family?

Yeah. My father played banjo in the early days and saxophone later. He was a senior, I’m a junior. And my mother, whose name was Grace, she was an entertainer, played piano and sang. And she had a fantastic talent. Never read music or anything but she had real good talent and could play anything that she heard. And my sister sang, my brother sang and played the piano. So we got into music quite early, in fact we were I guess four, five and six or something like this, we used to do three part harmonies to the…
